content.title: Arvada Urban Renewal Authority (AURA)
content.summary: The Arvada Urban Renewal Authority (AURA) focuses on revitalizing designated urban areas in Arvada by developing quality office, retail, and multi-family housing in distressed neighborhoods, thereby enhancing the city's vibrancy and residents' quality of life. AURA collaborates with various stakeholders, including property owners, developers, and city officials, and oversees five urban renewal districts. Monthly meetings are held on the first Wednesday at 3 PM at their office, and recruitment for board vacancies will begin in December.
content.body:
## Overview

[Arvada Urban Renewal Authority (AURA)](https://arvadaurbanrenewal.org/) is responsible for revitalizing urban areas designated throughout the community by creating successful, high-quality projects that will help produce a vibrant, cohesive city and enhance the quality of life for the citizens of Arvada.

AURA's goal to develop quality office, retail or multi-family housing within distressed neighborhoods in Arvada is achieved through partnering with property owners and developers. AURA collaborates closely with elected officials, city administrators, private developers, financing sources, as well as the community. AURA's revitalization efforts contribute to the economic stability of the City by increasing property values and sales tax.

AURA has five distinct urban renewal districts: [Ralston Fields](https://arvadaurbanrenewal.org/aura-development-areas/ralston-fields/), [Village Commons](https://arvadaurbanrenewal.org/aura-development-areas/village-commons/), [Jefferson Center](https://arvadaurbanrenewal.org/aura-development-areas/jefferson-center-nw-arvada/), [Olde Town Station](https://arvadaurbanrenewal.org/aura-development-areas/olde-town/) and [Northwest Arvada](https://arvadaurbanrenewal.org/aura-development-areas/jefferson-center-nw-arvada/).

## Meeting Information

- 3 pm
- 1st Wednesday of every month
- AURA Office  
  5603 Yukon Street, Suite B  
  Arvada, Colorado 80002

- 5 year terms
- Volunteer appointment

## Interested in Joining AURA?

Recruitment to fill vacancies on boards and commissions will begin in December. You can review the application process on the main [Boards, Commissions and Committees page](/248/Boards-Commissions-and-Committees).
